get.description:
> 🚧 This endpoint is in beta and subject to change. > > A beta revision header (2026-10-15.pre) is required to use our beta APIs. Klaviyo APIs in beta are not intended for use in production. See our [versioning and deprecation policy](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/api_versioning_and_deprecation_policy) for more information. List top-level folders (or all folders matching a filter). Lists root-level folders by default. To list one specific folder's children, use `GET /api/folders/{id}/children` instead.

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `10/s`
Steady: `150/m` **Scopes:** `folders:read` [OpenAPI Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/beta/apis/get_folders_beta.json)

parameters.name: additional-fields[folder]
parameters.description: Request additional fields not included by default in the response. Supported values: 'child_count', 'item_count'

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
For more information please visit https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/v2026-10-15.pre/reference/api-overview#filtering
Allowed field(s)/operator(s):
`name`: `contains` (string)
`folder_type`: `equals` (allowed values: `'media'`, `'email_template'`)

patch.description:
> 🚧 This endpoint is in beta and subject to change. > > A beta revision header (2026-10-15.pre) is required to use our beta APIs. Klaviyo APIs in beta are not intended for use in production. See our [versioning and deprecation policy](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/api_versioning_and_deprecation_policy) for more information. Rename and/or move a folder. `attributes.name` and `relationships.parent` are both optional and independently applied — send either or both in one call. Omit `relationships.parent` to leave it unchanged; send it as `null` to move the folder to root.

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `10/s`
Steady: `150/m` **Scopes:** `folders:write` [OpenAPI Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/beta/apis/update_folder_beta.json)

parameters.name: additional-fields[folder]
parameters.description: Request additional fields not included by default in the response. Supported values: 'child_count', 'item_count'

requestBody.description:
Request to rename and/or move a folder.

`name`/`parent` are independently optional — send either, or both, to update just that part. Omit `parent` entirely to leave it unchanged; send `parent: null` to move the folder to root.

folder_type.description:
Folder types a caller may create via the public API.

Deliberately narrower than the internal `FolderType` (`media` |
    `email_template`) — `email_template` is the only type with an end-
    to-end public item-membership path today.

FolderType.description:
Type/domain of a folder, constraining what objects it can contain.

M1 values: media folders hold images/videos/products, while
    email_template folders hold email template references.

Klaviyo-API-Key.name: Authorization
Klaviyo-API-Key.description:
Private key authentication for /api/ endpoints is performed by setting the `Authorization` header to `Klaviyo-API-Key your-private-api-key`
For more information please visit https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/v2026-10-15.pre/reference/api-overview#authentication
